department: Department of Rural Development / SERP, Government of Andhra Pradesh
summary: Monthly social security pension for old-age persons, widows, persons with disabilities and other listed groups (about 28 categories). It replaced YSR Pension Kanuka in 2024. Paid monthly by direct bank transfer.

eligibility.income_limit_note: Not found in sources. Confirm; ration card status and category rules may apply.

by_category.rule: 18 years or above (older source); needs spouse death certificate
At least 40% disability (SADAREM certificate); no age limit
by_category.monthly_inr_note: Up to Rs 15,000 for complete disability

by_category.category: Other groups (single women, fishermen, cobblers, ART/HIV, transgender, dappu artists)

documents.name: Aadhaar card
documents.why: Identity and age verification for old-age pension

documents.name: Age proof (where applicable)
documents.if_missing: Ask the secretariat what is accepted

documents.name: Spouse death certificate (widow pension)
documents.if_missing: Apply to the civil registration office

documents.name: SADAREM certificate (disability pension)
documents.if_missing: Get assessed through the disability certification process

documents.name: Bank account details
documents.why: Pension is paid by direct transfer

steps: Go to your Swarna Gramam or Swarna Ward (village/ward secretariat) centre when applications are open
Submit the application with the documents for your category
Initial eligibility check, then physical and departmental verification
If approved, the pension is credited monthly to your bank account

dates.latest_window: 07/09/2026 to 16/09/2026 (fresh applications), per a news report. Initial check 17-21 Sept, verification 22-24 Sept 2026.
dates.note: That window has passed (today is 07/10/2026). Next window unknown; ask the secretariat.

official_links_note: Official pension portal not yet confirmed. Check the AP Seva portal home page, which shows NTR Bharosa pension forms.
